outlook_summary: Neogen enters FY27 at transformational inflection with dual catalysts: Dahej commissioning (Feb 2027) normalizes legacy standalone business, while Pakhajan's H1–H2 ramp of electrolyte and salts unlocks India's first non-FEOC battery materials platform. Revenue guidance of ₹875–950 cr (6% growth) reflects stable specialty chem demand plus early battery ramp; strong customer visibility (US audits, global provisional approvals) and Morita partnership de-risk execution toward high-margin battery gro

Management is executing a dual-track growth strategy whilst navigating commodity inflation: scaling ADHO (20%+ FY26 growth, 81% of revenue base) and growing the profit portfolio from ₹225 cr (FY26) to ₹500 cr over three years. Organized trade channel has reached 30% of sales and is growing 20%+, providing premiumization leverage. Management is executing a deliberate repositioning from commodity strip supply toward higher-value components and assemblies, with evidence of mix shift (55%→65% component ratio) and realization gains (10-12% per kg) already embedded in FY26 results. Pune facility is strategically critical for automotive/electrification growth but deferred pending government approvals; commissioning timeline clarity will be a near-term inflection point.
